label: 绚烂纸本
description: 暖纸底上的青蓝与粉色透明洗染、干刷矢量和轻纸纤维；正文落在安静阅读面，照片承担真实证据。

tokens.color_motion: cool cyan and warm blush washes drift through one continuous warm-paper field without chapter-by-chapter hue resets
tokens.saturation: restrained paper and ink with luminous cyan, blush, and one blue accent; no black-white or neon jumps
tokens.material: warm uncoated paper, translucent watercolor bloom, dry-brush vectors, and subtle editable fiber grain
tokens.lighting: soft ambient paper light without glow balls, glass reflections, or dark technology panels
tokens.layering: paper, cool wash, warm wash, brush, grain, editable text, documentary photo, then interaction
tokens.edge_energy: feathered organic edges and a few asymmetric strokes while calm reading area remains at least 62 percent
tokens.copy_safe_zone: near-solid warm paper behind body copy; washes fade before text and measured contrast remains at least 4.5 to 1
tokens.photo_responsibility: only verified real photographs carry people, event, venue, project, or result evidence
tokens.background_responsibility: generated or vector backgrounds carry atmosphere and continuity only and never factual evidence

organization_derivation.paper: derive from the organization's neutral at lightness 94-97
organization_derivation.ink: derive from a dark step of the organization primary at lightness 28-39
organization_derivation.display: derive from a middle step of the organization primary at lightness 40-55
organization_derivation.cool_wash: mix paper with the organization primary at 18-24 percent
organization_derivation.warm_wash: mix paper with the organization secondary at 14-20 percent
organization_derivation.accent: use one middle secondary color only for large decorative information

ardot.art_type: Use 4-8 editable Chinese characters with an independent vector brush/accent layer; keep key information in a standard native text fallback.
ardot.interaction_surface: Closed, open, and fallback states share the same family seed and background coordinate system.

provenance_requirements.future_reuse_source: this preset file and its canonical grammar SHA-256
